verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents an official CLI at docs.coderabbit.ai/cli for reviewing uncommitted changes before committing. Its docs pitch the CLI for AI-native workflows: it plugs into coding agents such as Claude Code, which can trigger reviews and fix issues, and it can run in CI/CD pipelines. Pricing lists CLI and agent-loop reviews. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and evidence that the CLI does more than code review (e.g., command reference, triage or planning from the CLI).
